title: Formats
description: Human Resources letters ready to generate.

laboral.title: Employment letter
laboral.description: Proof that the person works at the company: job title, hire date and net monthly salary.
laboral.addresseeHint: Optional (for example: TO WHOM IT MAY CONCERN)
laboral.salaryNotStored: The salary is only used for the letter; it is not stored anywhere.

apercibimiento.title: Warning letter
apercibimiento.description: Formal warning about performance irregularities, with a signed acknowledgement.
apercibimiento.irregularitiesHint: Describe the irregularities in their work

daycare.title: Daycare letter
daycare.description: Letter for the IMSS daycare: employment data, work schedule, rest days and vacation period.
daycare.vacationHint: Optional: without days or dates the vacation sentence is not printed.

errors.loadPeople: Could not load the employee list
errors.loadProfile: Could not load the employee file
errors.needEmployee: Pick an employee to save the letter in their file
errors.save: Could not save the letter in the file

sectionEmployeeHint: Pick the person to prefill their file data.
sectionDataHint: Everything can be edited before generating.

purchaseRequest.title: Purchase request
purchaseRequest.description: Blank or filled-in form to request products or services, with authorization signatures.

quotationRequest.title: Quotation request
quotationRequest.description: Form to request a quote from a supplier, with price columns for the supplier to fill in.

request.optionalHint: Everything is optional: you can print the form blank.
request.itemsHint: The PDF always shows empty rows to complete by hand.
